title: Ticker Analysis v1
description: Solo mode output: single-ticker analysis with entry strategy and position sizing. Derived from StockEval Layer 2 JSON. All numeric values satisfy validation rules N1 (formula-value consistency), F1 (price vintage freshness), and S1 (source attribution).

schema_version.description: Schema version string. Increment on breaking changes.

as_of.description: Report timestamp, ISO 8601 with timezone. Top-level as_of required by Rule F1 for price vintage classification.

kind.description: Asset class. If present at top level, propagated to current_price by Rule F1 walker to determine staleness thresholds (equity: 26h block; muni_bond: 168h flag; cash: always acceptable).

current_price.description: Live market price. vintage must be within 26h of as_of for equity assets (Rule F1). source satisfies Rule S1.

p25.description: Lower quartile; strong-buy zone upper bound.

p95.description: Bull ceiling (95th percentile); exit trigger level.

distribution.description: Price distribution percentile anchors from the StockEval scenario engine. Vintage reflects when the analysis was generated.

expected_return.description: Probability-weighted expected return across bear/base/bull scenarios. formula = weighted sum of (scenario_price/current_price - 1). Rule N1 verifies formula against stored value within ±0.001 or ±0.5%.

current_zone_logic.description: Classification of current price relative to distribution. Drives zone presence: strong_buy_zone only present when current_below_p25 or current_between_p25_p50.

strong_buy_zone.description: Aggressive entry range [p5, current]. Null when current_zone_logic = current_above_p50. Invariant (Rule E1, future): high <= current_price.value.

ideal_buy_price.description: Optimal single-entry price point. Invariant (Rule E1, future): <= current_price.value.

starter_zone.description: Conservative first-tranche range. Null when current_zone_logic = current_above_p50. Invariant (Rule E1, future): high <= current_price.value.

trim_zone_above.description: Trim trigger price level (typically p75). Reduce position when price exceeds this.

entry_strategy.description: Entry zones and price-level triggers. Cross-field invariants (ideal_buy_price <= current_price.value; zone highs <= current_price.value) are documented here and will be enforced by Rule E1 in a future block.

target_size_pct.description: Target portfolio allocation percentage. Range: 0.0–5.0. Zero means no position recommended (Hold/Wait thesis). Derived from conviction level and Kelly inputs in v2; constant in v1.

recommended_now_pct.description: Initial tranche allocation percentage. formula = target_size_pct.value / tranche_count (expressed as numeric literals). Rule N1 verifies.

conviction.description: Qualitative conviction level. Low: max target 2%; High: min target 2%.

entry_style.description: Execution approach. aggressive: full position now; staged: tranches; wait: no entry.

tranche_count.description: Number of planned entry tranches for staged execution.

position_sizing.description: Portfolio sizing parameters. DerivedValues satisfy Rule S1 (derived: true) and Rule N1 (formula).

stockeval_layer2_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest (prefix 'sha256:') of the StockEval Layer 2 JSON that produced this output. Change detection: if upstream reruns, hash changes and this document must be regenerated.

stockeval_layer2_vintage.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the upstream StockEval analysis was generated.

upstream.description: Audit trail linking this output to its upstream input. Enables detection of stale derivations when Layer 2 data is refreshed.

vintage.description: ISO 8601 timestamp or date. Rule F1 uses this on price objects.

SourcedValue.description: A numeric value with explicit source attribution and data vintage. Satisfies Rule S1 via source field. Rule F1 applies to any SourcedValue whose JSON path leaf contains 'price'.

formula.description: Arithmetic expression: operators +  -  *  /  numeric literals and parentheses only. No variables. Evaluated by Rule N1 against stored value within ±0.001 or ±0.5%.

derived.description: Must be true. Satisfies Rule S1 derived-value exemption.

source.description: Optional attribution for the formula methodology itself.

DerivedValue.description: A numeric value computed from a pure arithmetic formula. Satisfies Rule S1 (derived: true) and Rule N1 (formula evaluated and compared to value).

PriceZone.description: A price range [low, high]. Invariant: high >= low. Cross-property constraints are not expressible in JSON Schema; enforced by Rule E1 (future).
